settings.heading: A coffee journey
settings.text:
Every week we taste through what other roasters have made, here and half a world away. Your subscription pulls from that same shelf — nothing set aside, nothing lesser.

You choose how you brew and who you want to hear from. We choose the coffee, and it is revealed when it arrives.

settings.heading: How it works
settings.lines:
Choose your brew method and the roasters you want to hear from
Pick a size, how many bags and how often
We choose the coffee — revealed when it arrives

settings.question: Can I choose the coffee I receive?
settings.answer: You choose how you brew and whether it comes from Australian or international roasters. Which coffee arrives is our call — that is the point.

settings.question: How do I manage, pause or cancel my subscription?
settings.answer: Log in to your account to skip a delivery, pause, change how often it comes, or cancel.

settings.heading: Still have questions?
settings.intro: Anything not covered here, get in touch and we will help.
